description:
## Goal

Replace the temporary 84% line-coverage floor with the strongest whole-number
floor supported by the current workspace, and remove the stale CI scaffolding
that promises restoration to only 87%.

## Current state

At origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`:

- `.coverage-threshold` contains `84`.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` still says the floor is temporarily lowered while
  `fz-9i4.7` defers broad compiler2 fixtures and that `fz-9i4.7.8` will restore
  it to 87.
- `fz-9i4.7` is closed, and `fz-9i4.7.8` is not present in the current ticket
  store.
- Nine explicit path deferrals remain across three fixtures, but they are
  already part of the current measured line universe and do not prevent a
  stronger coverage gate.

Commit `d5438ba089765ee170c8be0b9fb11be9e358a607` changed the threshold
from 87 to 84 and added the temporary CI comment.

## Measurement

The exact Linux CI run for this commit, run `33697417868`, completed
successfully. Its uploaded coverage artifact reports:

    104,776 / 116,848 lines = 89.66862933041216%

A fresh local CI-equivalent run also completed successfully:

    RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo llvm-cov \
      --all-features \
      --workspace \
      --fail-under-lines 87 \
      --json --summary-only \
      --output-path /tmp/fz-kdt23-coverage.json

Local result:

    104,778 / 116,856 lines = 89.66420209488602%

Therefore 89 is the strongest supported whole-number floor on both measured
platforms. A floor of 90 is not supported. Restoring only 87 would leave more
than two measured percentage points unenforced.

## Work

- Change `.coverage-threshold` from `84` to `89`.
- Delete the three-line temporary coverage comment from
  `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Keep `.coverage-threshold` as a bare number because CI reads it directly.
- Do not modify production code, tests, fixtures, or fixture deferrals in this
  ticket.
- Do not add replacement prose to CI; the coverage command and threshold file
  are self-explanatory.
- No separate documentation update is required: repository-wide search finds
  no coverage-floor documentation outside the stale CI comment.

## Checks

- `cat .coverage-threshold` prints `89`.
- This CI-equivalent command passes from a fresh coverage run:

      RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo llvm-cov \
        --all-features \
        --workspace \
        --fail-under-lines "$(cat .coverage-threshold)" \
        --json --summary-only \
        --output-path coverage.json

- `jq -e '.data[0].totals.lines.percent >= 89' coverage.json` passes.
- The normal CI lint, audit, doc-test, coverage, artifact, and badge jobs pass.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` contains no reference to `fz-9i4.7`,
  `fz-9i4.7.8`, or a temporarily lowered coverage floor.
- The implementation diff is limited to `.coverage-threshold` and removal of
  the stale CI comment.
title: Ratchet the temporary line-coverage floor from 84 to the measured 89 and remove its stale CI comment
